result.scope: NAVIL backend (C:/Users/carlo/OneDrive/Desktop/Navil_gg_website/globeguard-backend) — configuration, runtime entrypoints, deploy, scripts, src/config, src/lib, src/types, src/dashboard-overrides, tooling configs, email templates, and the four docs (README/CLAUDE/HANDOFF/PROJECT-CONTEXT). Payments/shipping/kustom plugin files were read only as far as needed to verify doc claims. node_modules is NOT installed in this checkout, so nothing was executed or type-checked; all statements are from reading source.
result.summary: The NAVIL backend is a Vendure 3.5.5 server (package.json:40-43) whose single config hub is src/vendure-config.ts. It registers 17 plugin entries (RedisCache [conditional], AssetServer, DefaultScheduler, DefaultJobQueue [DB-buffered], DefaultSearch, Email, Bexio, Cups, DashboardOverview, Dashboard, Payment, Shipping, Catalog, Blog, CarLookup, Faq, StoreLocator) at lines 148-217; KustomPlugin is NOT registered and NOT imported (only a KUSTOM_FRONTEND_BASE_URL env fallback at line 53 and KUSTOM_* typings in environment.d.ts:34-42 remain). Auth uses tokenMethod ['bearer','cookie'] with only a cookie secret configured, native auth for shop+admin, env superadmin, and guest checkout disabled (lines 105-117, 143-145). API paths are admin-api / shop-api (changed 2026-07-08 by a third-party commit 2005329 from admin / api), dashboard at /dashboard, assets at /assets with custom naming/preview strategies and optional prefixed S3 storage. Email is EmailPlugin with a per-locale LocaleAwareTemplateLoader (de/ + en/ folders exist for 4 events) and a SendgridEmailSender used only when SENDGRID_API_KEY is set; otherwise transport 'none' (emails discarded). Redis is used only by RedisCachePlugin (socket-or-TCP), the job queue is DB-backed; scripts/with-managed-redis.mjs wraps npm dev/start with auto-bootstrap of Postgres/Redis (docker compose or native) and, if CUPS_SERVER_URL is set, apt/brew/curl-installs CUPS client + Tailscale. Order codes are 'SE' + 5 random digits (Drivknuten-era prefix, 100k code space); two TypeORM subscribers sanitize quote characters out of customer/address names (generic). Deploy artefacts are split between the documented Hetzner konsoleH beta (deploy/app.js supervisor + backend.env.example, hardcoded driv.beta.globeguard.ch and /run/redis_drivkf socket) and an undocumented GitHub Actions workflow added 2026-07-08 that git-resets and pm2-restarts $HOME/apps/globeguard-backend on an SSH host held in secrets (default user 'register'). scripts/ contains the GlobeGuard catalog pipeline (build-catalog-and-compatibility.js, inspect-compatibility-excel.js, both with 'C:/Users/MSI PC/...' fallbacks), two Drivknuten ABS-ring DB scripts, two asset-sync scripts (one hardcoding C:/GG_Website/.env and the old /admin path), and four generic runtime helpers. Remaining Swedish/Drivknuten traces in the backend proper are concentrated in: order code prefix 'SE', dashboard-overrides/user-settings.tsx (sv/SE defaults), shared/customer-classification.ts ('Företag'/'Privat' group names, sv-SE normalisation), shipping-configuration.ts (Swedish priority codes, sv descriptions), shipping.plugin.ts (25% shipping tax), payments (sv descriptions), the todo file (Fortnox), README (lists fortnox/customer-import/virtual-products), and the whole src/plugins/kustom directory. The docs disagree with code on API paths, shipping method set, payment method set, plugin inventory (virtual-products gone, store-locator/catalog added), email template layout, availableLanguages, and V107-vs-V110 catalog numbers.

business_rules.rule: Guest checkout is disabled: customer accounts are mandatory because software licences, device serial numbers and update history are tracked per customer and supplier-side licence activation needs a durable identity.
Default shop language is German; English is secondary (email templates exist in de and en; product data carries name_de/name_en).

Shipping methods (placeholder rates, NET CHF minor units): Schweizer Post Priority CHF 15 (private customers), Schweizer Post Economy CHF 9 (private), Geschäftsversand CHF 25 (company customers), EU Versand mit Tracking CHF 35 (all), Selbstabholung Cham CHF 0 (all).

Payment methods auto-created on boot: Rechnung/Invoice (company customers only, offline Authorized payment requiring manual settlement), 'Kredit-/Debitkarte (SumUp)' and 'PayPal' (both placeholders using the invoice handler).
A customer is 'company' if in the CustomerGroup named 'Företag', 'private' if in 'Privat', otherwise treated as private; exposed to the storefront as activeCustomerClassification.
Order codes are 'SE' followed by 5 random digits, uniqueness enforced by DB lookup with up to 100 attempts.
Customer first/last/title and address fullName/company are stored with quote characters stripped and whitespace collapsed.
All catalog prices are NET CHF from the V110 price model; VAT is added by Vendure per tax zone; EUR display = CHF x 1.1 (frontend only).
Catalog seeding runs only when SEED_CATALOG=true|1 and re-upserts from data/*; it must be false after first boot to avoid overwriting dashboard edits.

Email sender defaults to '"GlobeGuard" <noreply@globeguard.ch>'; verification/password-reset/email-change links resolve to <EMAIL_BASE_URL or FRONTEND_BASE_URL>/verify, /password-reset, /verify-email-address-change unless overridden.

result.summary: The six plugins split cleanly into three groups. (1) CatalogPlugin + data/ + the build script are the authoritative GlobeGuard catalog model: 7 custom fields (Product.brandGroupId/tierKey, ProductVariant.compatibleFromYear/ToYear, OrderLine.selectedBrandGroupId/selectedYear/selectedBrandGroupIds, all public), a SEED_CATALOG-gated idempotent seeder that upserts 256 CSV rows + 4 multi-variant extras (16 duration variants), bootstraps CH tax (8.1%), retires 19 legacy SKUs by disabling, hides 27 GG-KAB-DEV-* SKUs, and seeds a 30-node collection tree via product-id-filter; it has no GraphQL extensions and no event subscribers. brand-compatibility.json has 81 brandGroup entries of which 4 are Excel legend rows accidentally parsed as brands (77 real, matching HANDOFF). (2) PaymentPlugin/ShippingPlugin/shared are structurally sound but carry Drivknuten residue: no PSP SDK exists anywhere (package.json has no payment deps); 'sumup' and 'paypal' methods are wired to the offline invoice handler as placeholders; shipping methods are already Swiss/German (5 methods, CHF rates) but the calculator taxRate constant is still '25' (Swedish VAT) and shipping-configuration.ts still lists Swedish method codes and sv-SE collation in dead helpers; the customer classification uses CustomerGroup names 'Privat' and 'Företag' (Swedish) with sv-SE lowercasing and is duplicated verbatim in the dashboard customer detail route. The classification IS load-bearing: it gates the invoice payment method (company only), the business-shipping vs Swiss-Post methods, and the shop-API query activeCustomerClassification that the NAVIL frontend calls. (3) KustomPlugin is complete, self-contained, NOT registered in vendure-config, introduces no entities/custom fields/permissions, and its only external touchpoints are 9 KUSTOM_* env typings, one env fallback line in vendure-config.ts, and 8 doc lines; nothing imports from it. BexioPlugin is fully self-contained (2 entities, 4 non-public custom fields, a Bexio CRUD permission set auto-granted to superadmin, GET /bexio/callback, 5 admin GraphQL operations), sync is manual-mutation-only with no event subscribers or scheduler, it is always registered in vendure-config with '' credential defaults, and nothing in code enforces the doc claim that 'Bexio stays LOCAL-only'; per HANDOFF it is untested against the live API and has several hardcoded TODOs (user_id/owner_id=1, country_id null, no shipping/discount positions, in-process OAuth state).

findings.evidence: Trigger: :95-102 env SEED_CATALOG must be 'true' or '1' else skipped. Flow :104-169: ensureDefaultTaxSetup -> read data/product-catalog.csv + extras.json + brand-compatibility.json (paths resolved from __dirname to repo root :110-113) -> upsertSingleVariantProduct per CSV row -> upsertMultiVariantProduct per extras product -> retireLegacyProducts -> seedCollections. Idempotency :76-78,:264,:322,:374,:424,:559: product looked up by slug (= skuToSlug(sku) :676-678), variant by SKU, collection by slug; update-in-place else create. Tax bootstrap :182-248: Country CH, Zone 'Switzerland', TaxCategory 'Standard' (isDefault), TaxRate 'Schweizer MwSt (Standard)' 8.1%, default Channel defaultTaxZoneId + defaultShippingZoneId set to the CH zone. Disabled SKUs :280-282: any SKU starting 'GG-KAB-DEV-' is created with enabled:false (27 rows in CSV). Retire pass :338-365 RETIRED_SKUS (19): GG-BASIC-WOMO, GG-UPD-{BASIC-CAR,BASIC-MOTO,BASIC-WOMO,PRO-CAR,PRO-MOTO,PRO-TRUCK,PRO-TRUMA,ELITE-MOTO,ELITE-FULL}-{STD,ABO}; disabled not deleted. Variants: trackInventory FALSE :311,:417; price = CHF*100 :260,:415. Multi-variant products get option group `<code>-duration` with options day/week/month/year ('1 Tag/Woche/Monat/Jahr') :615-661; tierKey SGW_LICENSE if category 'SGW License' else SERVICE :379. Collections :456-525 (30 defs): produkte/{basic/{basic-car,basic-moto,basic-womo}, pro/{pro-car,pro-moto,pro-truck,pro-trailer,pro-agrar,pro-industrial}, elite}; zubehoer/{pro-add-on(empty), sgw-bypass, adapterkabel, basiskabel, adapter, adapter-sets}; services/{sgw-license, ferndiagnose}; software-updates/{updates-basic, updates-pro, updates-elite, pro-erweiterung}. Membership via Vendure 'product-id-filter' :541-551; re-parented with collectionService.move :583-598.
findings.notes: BUG to fix on port: basic-womo collection matcher is `sku => sku === 'GG-BASIC-WOMO'` (:466-467) i.e. the RETIRED single WoMo SKU; the 11 live per-brand WoMo products GG-BASIC-WOMO-<SLUG> match no collection (basic-car matcher is startsWith('GG-BASIC-CAR-') :463). findings.notes: Worth keeping: it is the only B2B/B2C switch and gates invoice payment, business shipping, and the frontend query. No code creates the two CustomerGroups (grep for CustomerGroupService/createCustomerGroup in src: none) — they must be created manually in the dashboard, otherwise everyone is 'private' and the 'invoice' method is never eligible. Rename 'Företag' to a German name (owner to choose, e.g. 'Geschäftskunde'/'Firma') and 'sv-SE' -> 'de-CH' in lockstep with the dashboard route, or better: move to one exported constant. Note the cache key includes shipping/billing company fields (:34-35) but the classifier itself ignores them — company address does NOT make a customer 'company'; only group membership does.

risks: Placeholder 'sumup'/'paypal' payment methods are enabled:true and always eligible while backed by the offline invoice handler — a live customer could complete checkout with no payment collected (payment.plugin.ts:38-55,:121).
ShippingPlugin applies taxRate '25' (Swedish VAT) to every shipping method (shipping.plugin.ts:25,:163) — Swiss orders would be charged 25% tax on shipping.

PaymentPlugin and ShippingPlugin upsert their methods with fixed values on EVERY boot (payment.plugin.ts:88-116; shipping.plugin.ts:117-145), silently overwriting any rates/enabled flags an admin changes in the dashboard.

Customer classification depends on CustomerGroups 'Privat'/'Företag' that nothing seeds; if missing, every customer is 'private', invoice payment and business shipping are never eligible, and the dashboard route customers_.$id.tsx will reject saves. Renaming the Swedish group name must be done in backend + dashboard simultaneously.
Seeder collection bug: basic-womo matcher `sku === 'GG-BASIC-WOMO'` (catalog-seeder.service.ts:466-467) means the 11 live WoMo products are in no collection.
brand-compatibility.json carries 4 legend-row junk entries; any UI iterating brandGroups without a vehicleGroup filter will render them.

Bexio is untested against the live API (HANDOFF.md:183), stores OAuth tokens in plaintext, keeps OAuth state in-process (breaks with server+worker or multiple instances), hardcodes user_id/owner_id=1, omits shipping/discounts/tax_id from invoices, and re-running bexioSyncOrder creates duplicate invoices (no api_reference lookup).

BexioPlugin is registered unconditionally with '' credentials; despite the doc's 'LOCAL-only' decision its schema (bexio_connection, bexio_sync_event, 4 custom-field columns) and permission set ship to production under synchronize:true.

SEED_CATALOG=true left on in an environment re-upserts products, translations, prices and collections from data/* on each boot and re-runs the retire pass, overwriting dashboard edits (PROJECT-CONTEXT.md:461).

Bexio custom fields uid/vatNumber are public:false — the storefront cannot capture B2B tax identifiers, so the contact_type inference (company iff uid||vatNumber) will classify all web-registered customers as persons.
The build script depends on owner Excel files that are not in git; the committed data/* files are the only reproducible source until those files are placed in the merged workspace.
Kustom removal is low-risk (self-contained, unregistered), but the NAVIL frontend still has 12 files referencing Kustom checkout flows that must be removed/replaced alongside.

Read-only audit; all six plugin directories read in full; dashboard extensions read in full; dashboard app/lib inspected via grep + git history (no node_modules present, so no byte-level diff against upstream was possible).
result.summary: The six content plugins are all registered in src/vendure-config.ts:188-216 and, except car-lookup, are GlobeGuard-relevant and self-contained (each: own entities, CrudPermissionDefinition, admin+shop GraphQL, no seed data, no Swedish seed content). Blog (3 tables, translations, inline assets, JSON-LD BlogPosting with https://www.globeguard.ch/blog/{slug}, 4h cache) and FAQ (single jsonb-backed faq_section table keyed by SITE_PAGE/COLLECTION/BLOG owner + language) work and are consumed by the NAVIL frontend (blog only; no frontend consumes FAQ or store-locator shop queries yet). Store-locator is brand new (2026-07-16), Swiss-defaulted (Zürich coords), and its dashboard pages are Lingui-wrapped but never extracted into the .po catalogs. CUPS is a working label-print/Tailscale admin surface whose CupsService.printTo* methods have zero callers in src/, and whose health indicator is registered unconditionally in the service constructor (cups.service.ts:141), making /health permanently 503 wherever no CUPS listens on :631 (documented in PROJECT-CONTEXT.md:398-399,462). Car-lookup is pure Drivknuten: a REST controller (/carSearch/:regNr, /carResolve/:token, POST /carSearchDropdown) validating Swedish plates (^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{2}[0-9A-Z]$), calling an env-configured upstream (CAR_API_BASE_URL, endpoints /carsearchdata and /swe_dropdown_step_one..four), and running raw SQL against a "collectionModell" table and Collection.customFieldsSourcepath that no longer exist in this backend since the virtual-products plugin was deleted (commit 6f053ff); nothing GlobeGuard imports CarLookupService, and the only consumers are the NAVIL frontend's legacy CarLookupForm/CarIndicator that HANDOFF already schedules for removal. Dashboard-overview is a small KPI resolver but is also the plugin that declares dashboard.location pointing at packages/dashboard/src/i18n/dashboard-extension.ts, i.e. it is the entry point that loads every dashboard extension. packages/dashboard is a full vendored copy of @vendure/dashboard 3.5.5 (659 files, 12 MB, upstream README/storybook/e2e, 24 locale .po files of 1516 msgids) present since the 2026-04-08 initial commit, but it is NOT what gets built: the root depends on @vendure/dashboard 3.5.5 from npm (package-lock.json:8462) and root vite.config.mts overlays the fork by alias (@/vdb -> packages/dashboard/src/lib, user-settings override, and seven aliased route files). Only about 14 non-.po files under packages/dashboard changed after the initial commit; the files that differ from upstream in intent are the extensions (blogs, faqs, cups, store-locator, overview redirect, virtual-products routes), lib/framework/defaults.ts (blog nav section), the overview page index.tsx, and the seven aliased routes, several of which still query Drivknuten-only custom fields/operations (virtualSku, virtualProductCount, productFitmentAdmin, invoiceEmail/paymentTermsDays, Privat/Företag groups) that the GlobeGuard backend does not define. The CLAUDE.md/HANDOFF claim of ~60 hardcoded German/Swedish strings in blog-pages.tsx is stale: the file now has 50 <Trans>, 84 t`` and 24 t({message}) usages and exactly one Swedish literal left (placeholder at line 1304); the real i18n debt is that de.po has 398 empty msgstr entries covering every custom extension string, and store-locator strings were never extracted. Remaining Drivknuten remnants in scope are small and enumerated below (faq 'drivlina' page key and '/blogg/' path, blogs.api.ts default translation 'sv', user-settings default 'sv'/'SE', Swedish lpstat regexes in cups, Swedish msgids from product-fitment-tags-editor).

business_rules.rule: A blog post is visible in the Shop API only if published=true AND (scheduledPublishAt is null OR scheduledPublishAt <= now); publishedAt is stamped on first publish and cleared when unpublished.
Blog reading time = ceil(words/200), minimum 1 minute; content plain text is derived by stripping HTML from contentJson when present.
Blog slugs are unique; on create a colliding slug gets a numeric suffix (-2, -3, …); on update a collision raises 'A blog with this slug already exists'.
Blog ogImage defaults to featuredImage when not explicitly set.

Blog structured data is schema.org BlogPosting (headline, author Person, datePublished/dateModified, description) with mainEntityOfPage https://www.globeguard.ch/blog/{slug}; FAQPage JSON-LD is NOT included in blog structuredData (delegated to FaqPlugin).
Blog base-record fields (title, slug, content, excerpt, meta) are copied from the translation matching the channel default language, else the request language, else the first translation.
Featured images for blog posts must be WebP or AVIF; the dashboard rejects other MIME types.
One FAQ section per (ownerType, ownerKey or collectionId, languageCode); site-page FAQs are only valid for keys in SITE_FAQ_PAGE_DEFINITIONS; BLOG sections require ownerKey = blog slug.

Shop FAQ queries return only published sections for the request language; FAQ answers are sanitized (script tags, on* handlers, javascript: URLs removed); items with empty question or answer are dropped and sorted by sortOrder.
FAQ canonicalOwnerKey defaults to 'site:<pageKey>', 'collection:<slug>' or 'blog:<slug>'; the storefront should emit FAQ JSON-LD only on the page whose canonical key matches.
FAQ cache (12h) is invalidated on any CollectionEvent and on every upsert/delete.
Store locations are typed 'store' or 'workshop'; only published locations are returned by the Shop API; new locations default to published=true.

CUPS logical targets are default-printer, default-label-maker, default-shipping-label-maker; resolution order is DB configuration row > plugin/env option > (for default-printer only) the CUPS server's system default; otherwise printing throws 'No CUPS printer is configured for target'.
Cups permissions (Create/Read/Update/DeleteCups) are auto-added to the SuperAdmin role on every boot.
Tailscale connect requires either CUPS_TAILSCALE_AUTH_KEY, or an OAuth client secret plus at least one device tag.

Dashboard overview revenue = SUM(order.subTotalWithTax + order.shippingWithTax) over orders in the active channel with orderPlacedAt set, active=false and state not in (Cancelled, Draft); 'active accounts' = customers whose user is verified and has a lastLogin; percentage change compares against the immediately preceding period of equal length; latestOrders limited to 1..20 (default 8).

Car lookup (Drivknuten legacy): registration numbers must match Swedish format ABC123/ABC12D; internal kType/modell_id/WHEELID never leave the server; dropdown 'types' step returns opaque 30-day carTokens.

Blog tag suggestions are German constants (obd, diagnose, fahrzeug, wohnmobil, motorrad, lkw, bus, fernwartung, software-update, anleitung, installation, fehlerbehebung, zubehoer) plus category/brand names derived from collection sourcePath under roots produkte/katalog(/drivlina).

result.summary: The NAVIL frontend's business logic is concentrated in one pure-TypeScript module (src/services/globeguard-picker.ts, 304 lines, depends only on src/data/brand-compatibility.json) plus two large React components (TierPicker.tsx 372 lines, ProductConfigurator.tsx 1017 lines) and a Redux cart thunk (cartActions.ts cartAddConfiguredItems). The picker implements vehicle type -> brand group -> model year, with BASIC/WOMO/PRO sharing one merged "LKW / Bus / Trailer" option (TRUCK&BUS + TRAILER) and ELITE splitting Bus (GG-ELITE-BUS-MB) from Truck/Trailer (GG-ELITE-TRUCK-MB). A picked brand maps to a product via Product.customFields.brandGroupId, and the selection travels to /products/[slug] purely as URL query (?year=YYYY&extraBrands=id:year,id). ProductConfigurator derives the add-on plan (SGW bypass cable IVE/FCCA vs licence stellantis/mercedes/vag with day/week/month/year variants and 1-20 qty, PRO Erweiterung SKUs incl. INEOS surcharge SKU, Truma module + GG-CABLE-TRUMA prompt, ELITE Mixed 4-10 brand grid, ELITE free SGW multi-select) and publishes it to ShopPageProduct, which computes the live NET total and calls cartAddConfiguredItems to add the base line plus each add-on as separate Vendure order lines carrying OrderLine custom fields selectedBrandGroupId/selectedYear/selectedBrandGroupIds. Prices are NET Rappen from variant.price; the "TEXT_INCL_VAT" key is repurposed to "zzgl. MwSt."; EUR is a display-only x1.1 rate in a Redux currency slice. The GraphQL layer is Apollo against same-origin /shop-api with cookie sessions, a ?languageCode= link derived from the /en/ URL prefix, and a localStorage 'customerToken' (actually the channel token from login.channels[0].token) sent as the 'vendure-token' header. Checkout is account-gated client-side (cart notice + redirect to /account/login?view=login&redirect=/cart; faktura page bounces if no customerToken) and only the invoice ("faktura") path is functional: the non-invoice branch prepares a Kustom order and redirects to /cart/checkout, which server-redirects back to /cart (dead loop); /cart/checkout/[token] is a generic order-success page that never calls completeKustomPayment. Several template leftovers remain inside domain files: Swedish shipping-method codes (pickup/home-delivery/postombud/foretagsfrakt) drive sorting and private/company filtering, default address country 'SE'/'se', a Swedish error string in [token].tsx, /drivlina category routes in productCategories.ts and product-category-*.ts, and CarContext/GarageContext/CompatibilityStatusBadge built around Swedish registration data. Two logic problems worth escalating: cartDisplayTotals.ts back-extracts 8.1% VAT from what is now a NET subtotal (cart/checkout totals are therefore wrong under the NET rule), and brand-compatibility.json contains 81 entries of which 4 are Excel legend rows leaked by the build script (harmless to the pickers because of the vehicleGroup filter, but junk). Hardcoded "ab CHF" prices disagree between pages (BASIC 620 vs 583, PRO 820 vs 790, WoMo 848 vs doc 880). Verbatim-copyable: globeguard-picker.ts, the three JSON data files, shopCurrencies/shopLanguages, product-highlights.ts (after extracting vehicleTypeFromSku), completedOrderCache.ts, purchaseQuantities.ts, vat-and-shipping.ts constants. Everything else needs a rewrite for App Router + Tailwind/shadcn + next-intl + gql.tada, with the DE/EN copy objects (roughly 200 strings across 14 objects) extracted into message files.

business_rules.rule: Tier keys are exactly BASIC | WOMO | PRO | ELITE; WOMO is treated as the BASIC platform for year rules (basicFromYear applies to BASIC and WOMO; PRO uses PRO_FROM_YEAR).
PRO_FROM_YEAR = brand-compatibility.json.proFromYear || 1991; BASIC_FROM_YEAR = json.basicFromYear || 2008. JSON currently carries proFromYear 1991, basicFromYear 2008.
Per-brand BASIC override: getFromYear(BASIC|WOMO, brand) = brand.basicFromYear || 2008 (all 62 BASIC groups currently carry basicFromYear 2008, so no effective override exists today).
Selectable model years run from (current calendar year + 1) down to the tier/brand from-year, newest first.

Vehicle-type options for BASIC/WOMO/PRO (CONSUMER_VEHICLE_TYPES): car->['CARS&VANS'], moto->['BIKE'], truck->['TRUCK&BUS','TRAILER'] (merged into one 'LKW / Bus / Trailer' dropdown), agrar->['AGRAR'], industrial->['INDUSTRIAL']. Labels DE + labelEn.
getBrandsForTier(tier, vehicleType) = groups whose tiers[] includes tier AND whose vehicleGroup is in the option's vehicleGroups, sorted by displayName with localeCompare('de-CH').

Only vehicle types that have at least one brand in the tier are offered (getVehicleTypesForTier). Because the JSON flags BASIC only on CARS&VANS+BIKE groups and WOMO only on 11 CARS&VANS groups, BASIC shows Car+Moto, WOMO shows Car only, PRO shows all five. TierPicker hides the vehicle-type step when only one type exists (WoMo).
WOMO tier groups (11): fiat-alfa-romeo-lancia, ford, iveco-daily, land-rover, man-tg-e, mercedes-benz-pkw-van, nissan, peugeot-citroen, renault-dacia, toyota, vw-gruppe.

TierPicker state: default vehicleType = first available; changing vehicle type resets brand, both extra slots and year; year select disabled until a brand is picked; submit disabled until a product AND a numeric year exist.

Brand -> product mapping: tier products (fetched by Product.customFields.tierKey) are indexed by product.brandGroupId; selectedProduct = map.get(brand.id); displayed price = selectedProduct.variants[0].priceNet (NET). If a brand has no product the picker shows a 'Produkt ... wird geladen' hint and stays disabled.
Picker submit navigates to /products/[slug]?slug=<product.slug>&year=<YYYY>[&extraBrands=<encoded>]; the configuration lives ONLY in the URL query, not in local state.
Product slug = SKU lowercased, non [a-z0-9-] runs collapsed to '-', trimmed (skuToProductSlug). Used to fetch add-on products by SKU and to link ELITE cards.

PRO picker shows two optional extra-brand slots labelled 'Zusatzmarke 2/3 (optional)' (slotIndex+2); options = brands of the SAME vehicle type minus the main brand minus the other slot, plus ACCESSORIES modules with proAddOnSku (Truma) suffixed ' (Erweiterung)'. A brand may appear only once across main + slots; choosing a main brand that a slot holds clears that slot.

Extra slot model year is optional ('Noch nicht bekannt'); years come from getSelectableYears(tier, extraBrand); modules (proAddOnSku) get no year field; an SGW hint appears if getSgwRequirements(extraBrand, year) is non-empty.

encodeExtraBrands: entries joined by ',' as 'brandGroupId:year' or 'brandGroupId' when year is null; empty ids dropped. decodeExtraBrands: split ',' then ':' ; year = Number(part) || null; entries without id dropped.

getErweiterungSku(brand): proAddOnSku if set (Truma -> GG-PRO-TRUMA); else id contains 'ineos' -> GG-PRO-EXT-CAR-INEOS; else CARS&VANS -> GG-PRO-EXT-CAR, BIKE -> GG-PRO-EXT-MOTO, TRUCK&BUS or TRAILER -> GG-PRO-EXT-TRUCK; AGRAR/INDUSTRIAL/other -> null (no extension product).
PRO add-on modules = groups with vehicleGroup 'ACCESSORIES' and proAddOnSku. Only one exists: accessories-truma {proAddOnSku GG-PRO-TRUMA, requiresCableSku GG-CABLE-TRUMA, tiers []}.

getSgwRequirements(brand, year): if sgw.bypass and fromYear <= year <= (toYear ?? inf) push {type:'bypass-cable', detail: id.includes('iveco') ? 'IVE' : 'FCCA'}; if sgw.license and in range push {type:'license', detail: licenseGroup}. Both can apply for the same year (Fiat group 2020: bypass 2018-2020 AND stellantis licence 2020+). Order in array: bypass first, then licence.

SGW data in JSON (8 groups): bentley/bugatti/vw-gruppe -> licence vag 2020+; fiat-alfa-romeo-lancia -> bypass 2018-2020 + licence stellantis 2020+; iveco-daily -> bypass 2018+ (IVE); maserati -> licence stellantis 2020+; mercedes-benz-pkw-van -> licence mercedes 2021+; truck-bus-mercedes-benz-truck -> licence mercedes 2022+.
SKU maps: SGW_LICENSE_SKUS {stellantis: GG-SGW-LIC-STELLANTIS, mercedes: GG-SGW-LIC-MERCEDES, vag: GG-SGW-LIC-VAG}; SGW_CABLE_SKUS {IVE: GG-SGW-CABLE-IVE, FCCA: GG-SGW-CABLE-FCCA}.

Licence durations: codes day/week/month/year with labels '1 Tag/1 Woche/1 Monat/1 Jahr' and EN equivalents. The variant for a duration is matched by option.code === code OR option.code endsWith('-'+code) OR variant.sku endsWith('-'+CODE); fallback variants[0]. Default duration 'day', default quantity 1, quantity select 1..20.

Main-brand SGW section appears only when the product has brandGroupId AND a URL year AND requirements exist; it is auto-ticked (sgwSelected=true). Unticking opens SgwRemoveConfirmDialog (Keep / Continue without); when left unticked a red warning 'Achtung: Ohne SGW-Freischaltung ...' is shown. Quantity + duration selects appear only for licence requirements; duration options show the live NET price of that duration variant.

Licence add-on line = {sku, label '<SGW-Lizenz X> (<duration label>)' prefixed 'N× ' when qty>1, variantId of duration variant, quantity, priceNet, customFields {selectedBrandGroupId, selectedYear}}. Cable add-on line = {sku, label 'SGW-Bypass-Kabel (IVE|FCCA)', variants[0], quantity 1, customFields same context}. Add-on omitted (silently) if its product/variant has not been fetched yet.

Add-on products are fetched lazily by slug (fetchProductDetail(skuToProductSlug(sku))) for: main SGW SKUs, each extra brand's Erweiterung SKU + requiresCableSku + its SGW SKUs (if year known), all 5 SGW SKUs for ELITE devices, GG-CABLE-TRUMA for WoMo/Truma extension.

Per extra brand (URL order): (1) Erweiterung line qty 1 with customFields {selectedBrandGroupId: brand.id, selectedYear: year||undefined}; (2) if it is a module with requiresCableSku and trumaCableSelected -> cable-set line 'Adapterkabel-Set <name>' qty 1 cf {selectedBrandGroupId}; (3) if year known and extraSgwSelected[brand.id] ?? true -> SGW cable/licence lines (licence uses the MAIN sgwDuration, qty 1), deduped on (sku, selectedBrandGroupId).

Extra-brand SGW ticks default to checked (undefined treated as true); each extra brand has its own checkbox; if no year is chosen a hint links to /support/sgw ('eine Freischaltung können Sie jederzeit später erwerben').

Truma cable prompt: trumaCableSelected defaults true. Triggers: (a) product.slug startsWith 'gg-basic-womo' (WoMo device, per-brand SKUs), (b) product SKU === 'GG-PRO-TRUMA' (standalone Truma extension), (c) Truma module chosen as a PRO extra slot. (a)/(b) add GG-CABLE-TRUMA line 'Adapterkabel-Set Truma Combi' qty 1 (no customFields); (c) adds brand.requiresCableSku with cf {selectedBrandGroupId}. Unticking shows warning 'Ohne Adapterkabel-Set ist keine Truma-Diagnose möglich.' (no confirm dialog).

Year compatibility check on the product page: yearFits = (!compatibleFromYear || year >= from) && (!compatibleToYear || year <= to) from the SELECTED VARIANT's custom fields vs the URL year; misfit shows a red box plus 'Bitte prüfen Sie die PRO-Variante für ältere Fahrzeuge.'

Standalone PRO Erweiterung products (tierKey 'PRO_ERWEITERUNG'): GG-PRO-EXT-CAR-INEOS is fixed to the INEOS group; GG-PRO-TRUMA fixed to the ACCESSORIES group; GG-PRO-EXT-MOTO offers BIKE groups; GG-PRO-EXT-TRUCK offers TRUCK&BUS+TRAILER; any other (GG-PRO-EXT-CAR) offers CARS&VANS minus INEOS. A brand must be chosen (extensionValid) or add-to-cart is blocked with a toast; the chosen brand becomes selectedBrandGroupId of the base line.

ELITE Cars Mixed: SKU GG-ELITE-CARS-MX (detected by SKU or slug), min 4 / max 10 brand groups, eligible = ALL CARS&VANS groups sorted de-CH (includes evOnly Tesla and INEOS with no surcharge logic); toggling beyond 10 is ignored and unchecked boxes become disabled; eliteMixedValid = 4..10; add-to-cart blocked with toast 'Bitte wählen Sie zuerst mindestens 4 Markengruppen aus.'; selection encoded as comma-joined ids in OrderLine.selectedBrandGroupIds on the base line.

ELITE (non-Mixed) device = tierKey startsWith 'ELITE': free SGW multi-select, nothing preselected: 3 licence checkboxes (stellantis, mercedes, vag) each with its own duration select (default 'day', qty fixed 1) + 2 cable checkboxes (IVE 'Iveco Daily', FCCA 'Fiat-Gruppe'); these lines carry NO customFields.

ELITE no-SGW warning: eliteSgwNoneSelected = isEliteDevice && no tick; ShopPageProduct shows window.confirm('Sie haben keine SGW-Freischaltung gewählt ... Trotzdem ohne Freischaltung fortfahren?') and aborts on cancel.

ELITE routing: ELITE_DEVICES = CARS-MX & CARS-MB -> 'car'; MOTO-MB -> 'moto'; BUS-MB -> 'bus'; TRUCK-MB -> 'truck-trailer'; FULL-MB -> 'all'. ELITE_VEHICLE_TYPES keeps Bus and LKW/Trailer SEPARATE. /produkte/elite dims cards not matching the chosen type and shows a Bus hint; prices come from variants[0].priceNet of products fetched with tierKeys 'ELITE', 'ELITE_CARS_MIXED_10', 'ELITE_FULL'.

Standalone licence products (GG-SGW-LIC-* and GG-SVC-FERN) use the variant ('Ausführung') select as the duration selector and show a stock-up hint '<Tages|Wochen|Monats|Jahres>lizenzen haben kein Ablaufdatum und eignen sich daher für den Kauf auf Vorrat.'

Live total on the product page = selected variant priceNet + sum(addOn.priceNet * addOn.quantity); breakdown line 'Gerät X + Optionen Y' shown when add-ons exist; configurator footer lists 'Wird zusätzlich in den Warenkorb gelegt: <labels> — zusammen <total>'. The SEO price uses the device price only.

NET pricing: every price the storefront displays is Vendure variant.price (net, Rappen) exposed as priceNet; cart lines use unitPrice/linePrice (net) and subtotal = order.subTotal (net). The react-intl key TEXT_INCL_VAT is repurposed to 'zzgl. MwSt. – wird an der Kasse nach Lieferland berechnet' / 'excl. VAT – calculated at checkout based on delivery country' and shown under product prices and on cards.

Currency display: CurrencyFormat renders (value/100 * currency.rate) with Intl.NumberFormat('de-CH', currency=code). Currencies: CHF rate 1 (default) and EUR rate 1.1 (display-only; orders stay CHF). Selection lives in a Redux 'currency' slice persisted client-side; selector UI in DropdownCurrency/MobileMenuSettings.

Cart/checkout totals: getCartDisplayTotals treats cart.subtotal as VAT-INCLUSIVE and back-computes subtotalExVat = subtotal/(1+0.081) and tax = subtotal - subtotalExVat; total = subtotal + shipping. Because mapActiveOrderToCartState feeds the NET subtotal, the cart page and CheckoutCart show a 'Zwischensumme' that is net/1.081 and an 'Inkl. MwSt.' row extracted from net — inconsistent with the NET + 'zzgl. MwSt.' rule.

Shipping estimate in cart: order.shippingWithTax if a method is set; else first eligible method's priceWithTax (after private/company filtering); else fallback 9.90 CHF incl. below 200 CHF subtotal, free above. Tax row = taxSummary entry matching /mwst|vat|standard/i (else sum) + estimated shipping tax.

Shipping methods are sorted by the Swedish template priority ['pickup','home-delivery','postombud','foretagsfrakt'] and filtered by activeCustomerClassification: 'company' hides 'postombud', 'private' hides 'foretagsfrakt'. With the backend's new Swiss/German method codes these are no-ops.

cartAddConfiguredItems(product, options, quantity, context, addOns): addItemToOrder(base variantId = context.variantId || product.defaultVariantId || product.id, quantity, {selectedBrandGroupId, selectedYear, selectedBrandGroupIds}) then sequentially addItemToOrder(addOn.variantId, addOn.quantity, addOn.customFields) for each add-on in array order; then one cart sync (eligible shipping + classification + mapActiveOrderToCartState) and toast 'Produkt «<name> (+N)» wurde in den Warenkorb gelegt!'. Add-on quantities are NOT multiplied by the base quantity; a failure mid-loop leaves earlier lines in the order (no rollback).

Base line custom fields: selectedBrandGroupId = configuration.extensionBrandGroupId ?? product.brandGroupId; selectedYear = URL ?year; selectedBrandGroupIds = eliteMixedBrandIds.join(',') when ≥1 chosen.

addItemToOrder first calls ensureOrderIsInAddingItems (if activeOrder.state === 'ArrangingPayment' -> transitionOrderToState('AddingItems')), and only sends the customFields argument when at least one of the three fields is set. Non-Order results throw Error(message || errorCode).

Cart quantity edits are debounced 250 ms and pushed via adjustOrderLine per changed line; removal via removeOrderLine; removing an SGW line (SKU startsWith 'GG-SGW-') first opens SgwRemoveConfirmDialog (cart page and Dropcart).
Cart line badge (formatSelectionBadge): if selectedBrandGroupIds -> '<n> Markengruppen gewählt'; else '<brand displayName> · Modelljahr <year>' (parts optional, joined ' · ').

Account gate: cart page isAuthenticated = Boolean(user && user.id !== 'loading'); when false it renders TEXT_CHECKOUT_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED + LINK_CHECKOUT_SIGN_IN and 'Weiter zur Zahlung' redirects to /account/login?view=login&redirect=/cart; login honours same-site ?redirect=; /cart/checkout/faktura redirects to login (redirect back to itself) when localStorage.customerToken is missing. Backend has guest checkout disabled.

Payment selection: eligiblePaymentMethods (isEligible) mapped kustom|kustom-payment -> 'kustom', invoice|faktura -> 'invoice', sorted kustom first. Cart 'Weiter zur Zahlung': set shipping method; if 'invoice' -> /cart/checkout/faktura; otherwise prepareActiveOrderForKustom() then location = '/cart/checkout' which SSR-redirects back to /cart (Kustom path is a dead loop).

Invoice (faktura) checkout: requires invoice eligible + a shipping method else bounce to /cart; prefills billing from user + default address (country default 'SE'); optional different shipping address + comment; on submit re-checks invoice eligibility, calls checkoutWithVendure({payment:'invoice', shippingMethodId, items incl. selection custom fields, addresses, comment}, {isLoggedIn}); caches the order in sessionStorage and redirects to /cart/checkout/<order.code>.

checkoutWithVendure sequence: (ArrangingPayment -> AddingItems if needed) -> reuse active order if it has lines, else removeAllOrderLines + addItemsToOrder(inputs with customFields) -> if no activeCustomer and !isLoggedIn: setCustomerForOrder (guest; email required) -> setOrderShippingAddress -> setOrderBillingAddress -> eligibleShippingMethods must contain the selected id -> setOrderShippingMethod([id]) -> transitionOrderToState('ArrangingPayment') -> eligiblePaymentMethods -> 'kustom' => createKustomSession(); 'invoice' or other => addPaymentToOrder({method, metadata:{}}) then getOrderByToken(order.code). Errors are prefixed with CHECKOUT_* codes for i18n.
Address mapping to Vendure CreateAddressInput: fullName = first+last (fallback 'Customer'), countryCode = addr.country || 'se' (Swedish default).

/cart/checkout/[token] (order confirmation): consumes the sessionStorage-cached order by token, else accountApi.getOrderByToken with 3 retries on transient errors; clears the Redux cart; renders ShopPageOrderSuccess. It never calls completeKustomPayment (no callers anywhere), and its not-found fallback text is Swedish ('Ordern kunde inte hittas.').
business_rules.source: src/pages/cart/checkout/[token].tsx:43-94, :107; grep: completeKustomPayment has zero callers outside shop-checkout.ts

business_rules.rule: Catalog tier listing: products(options:{filter:{tierKey:{eq:$tierKey}}, take:100}) on the standard Shop API; on error falls back to fetching all products (pages of 100, cap 1000) and filtering client-side. Collection pages use search(input:{collectionSlug, groupByProduct:true}) and collection(slug){children} to render one section per child; known slugs zubehoer/services/software-updates have hardcoded DE/EN titles+descriptions.

Product highlights (device tiers BASIC/WOMO/PRO/ELITE* only): brand bullets parsed from brand-use-cases.json sentence after ':' (max 3) lead; generic bullets: read/clear all ECUs; 'all' type -> all-classes bullet; combustion (not evOnly, not moto) -> DPF/GPF+AdBlue; moto -> ABS bleeding; truck/bus/trailer -> air brake + tachograph; womo -> Truma unlock; evOnly -> coding/calibration wording instead of injector coding; live data; remote diagnostics 1st year. Generic bullets overlapping brand bullets (dpf/adblue/injector/battery/service) are dropped; cap 7 with brand bullets else 6.

VehicleTypeBadge.vehicleTypeFromSku: only 'GG-' SKUs; order: WOMO/TRUMA -> womo; ELITE-FULL -> all; GG-ELITE-BUS-MB -> bus; -CAR/-CARS/-INEOS -> car; -MOTO -> moto; -TRAILER -> trailer; -TRUCK -> truck; -AGRAR -> agrar; -INDUSTRIAL -> industrial; else none. Icons /images/vehicle-types/<type>.png.

Fixed header navigation (DE/EN): Warum GlobeGuard? (/warum-globeguard), GlobeGuard BASIC (/produkte/basic), GlobeGuard PRO (/produkte/pro), GlobeGuard ELITE (B2B) (/produkte/elite), Zubehör (/produkte/kategorie/zubehoer), Services (/produkte/kategorie/services), Updates & Erweiterungen (/produkte/kategorie/software-updates), Support (/support). Note: line 100 references an undefined GLOBEGUARD_HEADER_MENU (ReferenceError if useProductCategoriesSafe runs outside the provider).

Route map: / , /geraet-finden, /unterstuetzte-marken, /produkte, /produkte/basic|womo|pro|elite, /produkte/kategorie/[slug], /products/[slug] (English segment kept), /cart, /cart/checkout (redirect), /cart/checkout/faktura, /cart/checkout/[token], /support/sgw, /account/login?view=login.

Homepage/product-hub marketing copy hardcodes 'ab' prices: index.tsx BASIC CHF 620.00 / PRO CHF 820.00; geraet-finden.tsx and produkte/index.tsx BASIC CHF 583.00 / PRO CHF 790.00 / ELITE CHF 1'980.00; basic.tsx SEO 'PKW & Van ab CHF 620, Motorrad ab CHF 583, WoMo CHF 848'; womo.tsx 'CHF 848 netto', Truma cable 'CHF 90.00'; pro.tsx 'PKW & Motorrad ab CHF 820, LKW/... CHF 1'050'.

business_rules.rule: Language handling: Next i18n locales ['de','en'], defaultLocale 'de'; page copy chosen by useIntl().locale.startsWith('en'); Vendure data language via ?languageCode=de|en appended to every Apollo request (explicit context.languageCode from SSR pages via vendureLanguageCode(locale), otherwise derived from the /en/ URL prefix in the browser). Picker labels use localizedLabel(entry, locale) -> labelEn when locale starts with 'en'.

integration_facts.fact: GraphQL client: Apollo Client 4 (@apollo/client ^4.1.4) with link chain languageLink -> authLink -> httpLink; uri '/shop-api' same-origin in the browser (Next rewrites /shop-api/:path* to BACKEND_URL/shop-api), `${getBackendUrl()}/shop-api` during SSR; credentials:'include' (cookie session); default fetchPolicy 'no-cache'.

Auth token: on login the storefront stores login.channels[0].token (the Vendure CHANNEL token, not a session token) in localStorage 'customerToken' and sends it as header 'vendure-token'; an optional localStorage 'authToken' is sent as 'authorization: Bearer ...'. Real authentication is the session cookie. signOut removes 'customerToken' and clears the Apollo store; isAuthenticated() = presence of 'customerToken'. AuthContext/isLoading also key off 'customerToken'.

Language link: uri = `${api}?languageCode=${explicit context.languageCode || detectClientLanguageCode()}`; detectClientLanguageCode returns 'en' iff window.location.pathname is '/en' or starts with '/en/'; SSR callers pass vendureLanguageCode(locale) via query/mutation `context`.

product-search.api.ts bypasses Apollo: raw fetch POST to '/shop-api' (browser) or backend URL (SSR), credentials:'include', no vendure-token header and no languageCode. Only fetchProductSearch (standard `search` query) is exported; COLLECTION_PRODUCT_SEARCH_QUERY (productCollectionProducts) and PROMOTION_OFFER_PRODUCT_SEARCH_QUERY (productPromotionOffers) target the removed VirtualProductsPlugin and are dead.

Custom fields referenced: Product.customFields.brandGroupId (string, id from brand-compatibility.json), Product.customFields.tierKey (string; values used: BASIC, WOMO, PRO, ELITE, ELITE_CARS_MIXED_10, ELITE_FULL, PRO_ERWEITERUNG), ProductVariant.customFields.compatibleFromYear / compatibleToYear (int|null), OrderLine.customFields.selectedBrandGroupId (string), selectedYear (int), selectedBrandGroupIds (string, comma-separated ids). Mutation input type OrderLineCustomFieldsInput; also passed inside AddItemInput.customFields for addItemsToOrder. tierKey must be a PUBLIC and FILTERABLE custom field for products(options:{filter:{tierKey:{eq}}}).

active-order.api.ts operations: query GetActiveOrderStateForCart {activeOrder{id state}}; mutation TransitionOrderToStateForCart(state); fragment ActiveOrder on Order {id code state currencyCode totalQuantity subTotal subTotalWithTax shippingWithTax total totalWithTax taxSummary{description taxRate taxTotal taxBase} lines{id quantity unitPrice unitPriceWithTax linePrice linePriceWithTax customFields{selectedBrandGroupId selectedYear selectedBrandGroupIds} productVariant{id name sku product{id slug featuredAsset{id source preview} assets{id source preview}} featuredAsset{id source preview}}} shippingLines{priceWithTax shippingMethod{id code name description}}}; query GetActiveOrder; query GetEligibleShippingMethods {eligibleShippingMethods{id code price priceWithTax}}; query GetActiveCustomerClassification {activeCustomerClassification} (CUSTOM backend query returning 'private'|'company', from the Swedish ShippingPlugin); mutation SetActiveOrderShippingMethod(shippingMethodId:[ID!]!); mutation AddItemToOrder(productVariantId, quantity, customFields: OrderLineCustomFieldsInput) with InsufficientStockError fragment; mutation RemoveOrderLine(orderLineId); mutation AdjustOrderLine(orderLineId, quantity).

catalog.api.ts operations: fragment CatalogProductFields on Product {id slug name description featuredAsset{preview} customFields{brandGroupId tierKey} variants{id sku name price priceWithTax currencyCode customFields{compatibleFromYear compatibleToYear}}}; query TierProducts($tierKey,$take,$skip) products(options:{filter:{tierKey:{eq}},take,skip}){items totalItems}; query AllCatalogProducts; query CollectionSearch($input: SearchInput!) search(input){totalItems items{productId slug productName description sku productAsset{preview} price{...SinglePrice{value} ...PriceRange{min max}}}}; query CollectionChildren($slug) collection(slug){id name slug children{id name slug}}. Normalised to ICatalogProduct{priceNet = variant.price}.

products.api.ts: query ProductDetail($slug) product(slug){id name slug description featuredAsset{preview source} assets{id preview source width height} customFields{brandGroupId tierKey} variants{id name sku price priceWithTax currencyCode stockLevel featuredAsset{preview source} options{code name group{code name}} customFields{compatibleFromYear compatibleToYear}}}; mapped to IProduct with price = variants[0].price (net), variants[] as IProductVariantInfo{priceNet, options{groupCode,code,...}}, images from assets.source||preview else featuredAsset else '/placeholder.avif', stock from variants[0].stockLevel (IN_STOCK/LOW_STOCK -> in-stock).

shop-checkout.ts operations: GetActiveOrderState; RemoveAllOrderLines; AddItemsToOrder($inputs:[AddItemInput!]!){order{...} errorResults{...}}; SetCustomerForOrder($input: CreateCustomerInput!); SetOrderShippingAddress / SetOrderBillingAddress($input: CreateAddressInput!); EligibleShippingMethods{id code price description}; SetOrderShippingMethod([ID!]!); TransitionOrderToState($state); EligiblePaymentMethods{id name code isEligible}; AddPaymentToOrder($input: PaymentInput!) with {method, metadata:{}}; GetActiveCustomerForCheckout{activeCustomer{id}}. HANDOFF.md §6 says brand-compatibility.json has 77 entries; PROJECT-CONTEXT.md:142 says 81; the shipped file has 81 = 77 real + 4 Excel legend rows (vehicleGroup '✔', '(✔)', 'ab JJJJ', 'JJJJ– / JJJJ–JJJJ', tiers ['PRO']). HANDOFF's 'PRO: 76' equals 80 minus the 4 junk rows.

HANDOFF.md §4.2 describes BASIC WoMo as '1 SKU … chassis brand picked at order', but the code expects per-brand products: slug prefix 'gg-basic-womo' (ProductConfigurator.tsx:276), tierKey 'WOMO' fetch (womo.tsx:91) and 11 groups flagged WOMO in the JSON; PROJECT-CONTEXT §3.1 describes '1 car/van brand + Truma module' without the SKU model.

MwSt.' (true for product/card labels, de.json:706), but cart and checkout totals (cartDisplayTotals.ts:21-32, cart/index.tsx:527-566, CheckoutCart.tsx:77-101) still present a VAT-inclusive breakdown ('Zwischensumme' = net/1.081, 'Inkl. PROJECT-CONTEXT.md:193 says encodeExtraBrands' 'id:year,id' format is stored 'in order-line custom field'; in code it exists only in the URL query 'extraBrands' (TierPicker.tsx:167-171, ProductConfigurator.tsx:251-254). PROJECT-CONTEXT.md §3.1 says BASIC-INEOS support is '~2022+'; brand-compatibility.json has cars-vans-ineos basicFromYear 2008 and no INEOS-specific year logic, so the BASIC picker offers INEOS model years back to 2008.

PROJECT-CONTEXT.md:196 says auth state is 'token in localStorage.customerToken'; the stored value is login.channels[0].token (the CHANNEL token, account.api.ts:411-414) sent as the 'vendure-token' header, while the actual session rides on the cookie (credentials:'include'). The gate therefore checks channel-token presence, not a session.

HANDOFF.md §5 says the ELITE product page has an 'SGW dropdown with no quantity limit'; code offers per-licence-group checkboxes with a duration select and a fixed quantity of 1 (ProductConfigurator.tsx:532-537, 927-966). Only the main-brand licence on BASIC/PRO pages has a 1-20 quantity select.

PROJECT-CONTEXT.md §5 says KustomPlugin is 'complete but NOT registered'; the frontend's non-invoice payment path (cart/index.tsx:329-330) redirects to '/cart/checkout', which SSR-redirects back to '/cart' (checkout/index.tsx:6-11); completeKustomPayment has no callers; [token].tsx is a generic success page. PROJECT-CONTEXT.md §6 route list omits /produkte/womo, /geraet-finden and /unterstuetzte-marken which exist (url.ts:26-30, pages/).

HANDOFF.md §3 says 'Sales price = NET + VAT by delivery address'; the frontend's fallback tax logic hardcodes CH 8.1% (vat-and-shipping.ts:14) and its address forms default to Sweden ('SE' faktura.tsx:52; 'se' shop-checkout.ts:318).
risks: cartDisplayTotals.ts / CheckoutCart.tsx present VAT-inclusive math on a NET subtotal — customers currently see a subtotal lower than the net sum of lines and a fictitious 'Inkl. MwSt.' row; must be fixed, not ported.
Add-on quantities are not multiplied by the device quantity (cartActions.ts:164-167; ShopPageProduct.tsx:148-153): ordering 2 WoMo devices yields 1 Truma cable line.
cartAddConfiguredItems performs N+1 sequential addItemToOrder calls with no rollback; a failure mid-way leaves a partially configured cart and shows only a toast.

Vendure's default OrderLine merging: identical variant + identical customFields merge into one line. ELITE SGW cable/licence lines carry no customFields, and standalone licence lines added twice would merge — acceptable, but the backend's merge strategy must be confirmed to honour selectedBrandGroupId/selectedYear so two PRO Erweiterung lines for different brands stay separate (not verified in backend).

brand-compatibility.json ships 4 junk legend rows (tiers ['PRO']); getBrandGroupName/ALL_BRAND_GROUPS consumers and any future 'all PRO groups' listing would expose them. Fix in the backend build script before regenerating for the merged repo.

The whole configuration (year, extra brands) lives in the product-page URL; the App Router port must read useSearchParams and keep those params on locale switches, variant changes and back-navigation, or SGW/Erweiterung add-ons silently disappear.

Auth gate relies on localStorage 'customerToken' (a channel token) rather than a verified session; SSR pages in the App Router cannot see it. Re-base the gate on activeCustomer (server) or on the backend's real session/bearer token.

Swedish leftovers in domain files must not be copied: shipping codes pickup/home-delivery/postombud/foretagsfrakt (shipping-methods.ts, customerGroupClassification.ts), country defaults 'SE'/'se' (faktura.tsx:52, shop-checkout.ts:318, :666), 'Ordern kunde inte hittas.' ([token].tsx:107), 'i morgon' (ProductCard.tsx:366), isSwedishLocale alias (locale.ts:11), '/drivlina' routes (productCategories.ts, product-category-query.ts), regNr/RegNr/WHEELID (product-category-query.ts, GarageContext.tsx, CompatibilityStatusBadge.tsx), 'Payment link images' Mastercard/Visa/PayPal (ShopPageProduct.tsx:559-577), SEO 'auto parts, car parts' (ShopPageProduct.tsx:363-365), SHIPPED_FROM_STOCKHOLM key name (value already 'Versand aus Cham').
Hardcoded 'ab CHF' prices on 6 pages have already drifted from each other and from the price list; render from catalog data in the merged frontend.
ProductCategoriesContext.tsx:100 references an undefined identifier (GLOBEGUARD_HEADER_MENU) — a latent ReferenceError if useProductCategoriesSafe runs without the provider.

tierKey filtering (products(options:{filter:{tierKey:{eq}}})) silently falls back to fetching up to 1000 products client-side if the custom field is not filterable/public; verify the backend custom-field config so SSR stays fast.

Licence variant matching depends on SKU suffixes -DAY/-WEEK/-MONTH/-YEAR or option codes ending -day/-week/-month/-year; renaming variants in the backend breaks duration selection with a silent fallback to variants[0].
ELITE Mixed eligible list includes Tesla (evOnly) and INEOS (which carries a +60 CHF surcharge elsewhere) with no surcharge line — possible pricing gap.
getSelectableYears offers next calendar year (currentYear+1) — intentional for model years but worth confirming against compatibleToYear handling.

Mollie replacement: checkoutWithVendure's addPaymentToOrder branch and the /cart/checkout stub must become createMolliePaymentIntent + redirect; the return page ([token].tsx) must resolve the order by code after redirect, where Vendure has not yet necessarily settled payment — the existing 3-retry lookup is not a payment-state poll.

result.summary: The NAVIL frontend is a Next.js 16.1.6 PAGES-router storefront forked from the RedParts/Drivknuten template (package.json name is still "drivknuten" v1.2.0, README still says drivknuten.se). It uses Bootstrap 5 + a 200-file/1.2 MB RedParts SCSS tree, Redux (next-redux-wrapper), react-intl with public/i18n/de.json + en.json (898 identical keys each), and Apollo against a Vendure shop API reached via same-origin rewrites (/shop-api and /api -> BACKEND/shop-api). There are 49 route files. GlobeGuard-authored pages (index, geraet-finden, unterstuetzte-marken, warum-globeguard, support, support/sgw, produkte/*, search) carry bilingual DE_COPY/EN_COPY objects and are driven by brand-compatibility.json; they are the copy/logic that must be ported. Generic commerce pages (account/*, cart, blog, 404) are template code whose UI the NEW App Router frontend already replaces, but the account pages still embed the Drivknuten "garage" (CarLookupForm, GarageContext, CarIndicator in the mobile header). Clearly Drivknuten-specific and to be dropped: wishlist, track-order, account/garage, car.api.ts + /car* rewrites, the localStorage car/garage services, all seven legal/about documents in src/data/site-documents.ts (Swedish, Helsingborg, Klarna/Swish, 99 kr), contact-us (Swedish + [INFO] placeholders), terms (lorem ipsum + signature.jpg), faq (lorem-ipsum answers, not wired to the backend faq plugin), robots.txt (drivknuten.se sitemap), 502 Swedish auto-parts 'category images', old/ page captures, and 46 CATEGORY_ + 58 GROUP_ auto-parts i18n keys. Kustom checkout remnants (checkout/[token] skeleton, faktura invoice page, CartPaymentMethods/CheckoutPayments kustom entries, TEXT_PAYMENT_KUSTOM_* keys, /kustom/create-session) are superseded by Mollie. Worth carrying: SEO plumbing (SEO.tsx defaults, structured-data.ts JSON-LD builders, route-indexing.ts noindex rules, middleware X-Robots-Tag, sitemap.xml with de-CH/en/x-default hreflang) after fixing residual Drivknuten values (areaServed 'SE', /drivlina search URL); theme.ts (colors #0F1E4A/#0083C2, GlobeGuard GmbH contacts), shopCurrencies.ts (EUR = CHF x 1.1 display-only), shopLanguages.ts, social-links.ts, blog helper services, the hand-curated GLOBEGUARD_HEADER_MENU_DE/EN, footer link structure, GlobeGuard logos, hero background, vehicle-type icons, 76 brand logos, the supported-brands PDF, and the German/English i18n values for the ~88 GlobeGuard-domain keys. Deployment is a GitHub Actions SSH job (secrets SSH_HOST, SSH_PRIVATE_KEY; user 'register', port 222, $HOME/apps/globeguard-frontend, pm2 'globeguard-frontend' on port 8000, waits for backend at 127.0.0.1:3000/shop-api) plus a Dockerfile (node:22, next build --webpack, port 3100, build arg NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=http://server:3000). Notable defects found: hardcoded 'ab CHF' teaser prices disagree between index.tsx (620/820) and geraet-finden.tsx (583/790/1'980), typescript.ignoreBuildErrors is true (hiding e.g. an undefined GLOBEGUARD_HEADER_MENU reference in ProductCategoriesContext.tsx:100), shippingMethodPresentation.ts serves Swedish labels for the German locale, and the sitemap omits most GlobeGuard pages.

result.summary: The NEW frontend is a fork of Vendure GmbH's official Next.js App Router storefront starter (LICENSE: "Copyright (c) 2025 Vendure GmbH"; README still carries create-next-app/Geist/Vercel boilerplate; Footer message keys are relabelled starter keys `vendure/github/documentation/sourceCode/poweredBy`; unused public/next.svg and vendure.svg; FeaturedProducts hardcodes the starter demo collection slug "electronics"). Stack: Next 16.2 App Router, React 19.2, Tailwind 4.3 with CSS-first `@theme inline` tokens, shadcn 4.12 "base-vega" style on @base-ui/react (not Radix; 61 ui files, all stock except a custom password-input), next-intl 4.13 (locales en/de, defaultLocale EN, default `always` prefix), next-themes class dark mode, gql.tada client typed against the NEW backend schema. The design tokens ARE GlobeGuard-branded: primary 200 100% 38% (#0083C2), secondary 224 69% 17% (#0E1E4B), accent #4594E1, dark background #060D22, radius 0.5rem, Inter + JetBrains Mono (Google Fonts CSS @import) with Geist loaded redundantly via next/font as fallback; NAVIL uses Roboto. Component-level styling is inconsistent with the tokens: dozens of hardcoded hex values from an earlier teal/ink theme (#101820, #007C9A, #58D7EF, #087DAA, #006f8f, #bdd3dc) and 37 uses of non-existent Tailwind shades (slate-250/350/405/450/650/850/855) that silently render nothing. Layout: sticky navbar with hardcoded English-only hover dropdowns (Products/Solutions/Supported Vehicles/Company) that ignore Vendure collections and the messages files; mobile Sheet nav does use Vendure top collections; a breakpoint mismatch (desktop nav `xl:flex`, mobile trigger `md:hidden` inside an `xl:hidden` wrapper) leaves 768-1279px viewports with no navigation. The currency picker component switches a real Vendure channel currency via cookie + `currencyCode` query param (not NAVIL's display-only CHF x1.1 rule) and is not even mounted in the navbar; SearchInput, NavbarCollections, HeroSection and FeaturedProducts are dead code. The footer is hardcoded English with an invented IA (GlobeGuard "Camper" product, "Update Subscriptions", "Careers", legal links all pointing to /contact, a fake "Dealer-Level Infrastructure Active" status). The home page is a 13-section marketing page with inline (non-i18n) copy encoding many unverified or wrong claims (tier feature ladders contradicting NAVIL's "feature depth identical across tiers", Renault SGW, "Camper Pack"/"Elite Set" with AI-generated mockup images whose Midjourney prompts ship in the code, three fabricated named testimonials, a fake terminal animation reading "SGW Bypass Payload... [INJECTED]", a 30-brand hardcoded list including Caterpillar/John Deere/Putzmeister) plus the NEW compatibility wizard. Product/collection/search templates are structurally sound (breadcrumbs, image carousel, variant radio groups, facet sidebar, grid/list toggle, sort, pagination, related carousel) but carry wrong logic: regex-on-product-name heuristics for visual kind/digital/package contents, a fake VinChecker that always succeeds, a `brand` search param that is never applied to the Vendure query, and non-functional static tabs. Partners/support/contact pages have keepable layouts but unverified data (15 partners, 2026 trade-show dates, phone +41 78 303 30 11, Mon-Fri 08-17, six "Available" downloads that only link to /contact, a contact form with no handler). i18n: 455 keys x 18 namespaces in both locales, but 11 German strings in Hero/Home/Footer/Common have umlauts replaced by literal "?", most layout/home copy bypasses messages entirely, German content files avoid umlauts ("Werkstaetten"), and the OG image is starter boilerplate ("Vendure Commerce"). Sitemap is static (5 routes x 2 locales, no products/collections), robots and revalidate route are reusable, but revalidate TAG_RULES do not match the tags actually used in code and cached.ts claims caching it does not implement. No Dockerfile; deploy.yml SSHes into Bilregistret infrastructure (user `register`, port 222, pm2 on port 8000) and must be replaced by NAVIL's Hetzner/Docker setup; next.config uses `output: 'standalone'` (good for Docker) but only allows localhost image hosts.

business_rules.rule: All catalogue prices are NET CHF; storefront shows 'zzgl. MwSt.'; CHF is the default; EUR = CHF x 1.1 via a display-only currency selector; VAT applied at checkout by delivery address.
Guest checkout is disabled; customer accounts are mandatory (DefaultGuestCheckoutStrategy allowGuestCheckouts:false).
Primary UI language is German; en secondary; fr/it routing-ready without content.
Brand colours: Hellblau #0083C2, Slider #4594E1, Hellgrau #d9dee8/#D9DCE5, Header Dunkelblau #0e1e4b, Footer #0d203b/#0E1E4B, Standard-Dunkelblau #0f1e4a; hero gradient #0e1e4b -> #0083c2.
NAVIL/old-site body font is Roboto (Google Fonts 400/500/700).

Tiers are BASIC (1 brand), WoMo (1 car/van brand + Truma module), PRO (expandable), ELITE (Cars Mixed 4-10 / <class> Multibrand / Full). Rule: 4+ brands = ELITE, never PRO. Diagnostic feature depth is identical across tiers; tiers differ only in brand count, model-year coverage and audience. BASIC/PRO B2C, ELITE B2B.
'85+ manufacturers / 1800+ models' describes the whole database, never a single device.
Picker spec: vehicle type -> brand -> year. BASIC/PRO treat Truck/Bus/Trailer as one dropdown; ELITE splits Bus and Truck/Trailer.
SGW licence unlock brands are Stellantis (post-2018), Mercedes-Benz, VAG with duration variants day/week/month/year; 'you can always buy later' messaging is intentional.

result.summary: The NEW frontend is a Next.js 16 App Router storefront (next ^16.2.9, react 19, next-intl 4, Tailwind 4, shadcn/base-ui, gql.tada, zod/react-hook-form) that talks to Vendure exclusively from the server (server components + server actions) through a small hand-rolled fetch client in src/lib/vendure/api.ts: POST to VENDURE_SHOP_API_URL (default http://localhost:3000/shop-api), channel token in the `vendure-token` header, auth as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` where the token is read from a Next cookie named `vendure-auth-token` and refreshed from the `vendure-auth-token` response header; languageCode and currencyCode are passed as `?languageCode=`/`?currencyCode=` query params. All GraphQL documents are typed with gql.tada against src/graphql-env.d.ts, which was generated from a STOCK Vendure 3.7.0 shop schema (every `customFields` is the JSON scalar, no ProductCustomFields/OrderLineCustomFields types, no compatibility or Mollie types), so the compatibility feature had to be implemented with untyped `rawQuery` strings against the NEW backend's globeguard-data plugin (compatibilityOptions / compatibilityRecommendation / productCompatibility) and is the wrong-logic core. The cart uses addItemToOrder(productVariantId, quantity) with no order-line customFields and no multi-line add, adjustOrderLine, removeOrderLine, applyCouponCode/removeCouponCode via server actions and `updateTag('cart')`. Checkout is an accordion step machine (contact [guest only] -> shipping address -> delivery -> payment -> review) whose place-order action does transitionOrderToState('ArrangingPayment') + addPaymentToOrder({method}) synchronously and redirects to /order-confirmation/[code]; there is no redirect-based payment flow, no Mollie support, and guest checkout is assumed possible (GuestCheckoutError is only surfaced reactively as an alert in the contact step). Account (profile/email/password/addresses/orders), sign-in/register/verify/verify-pending/forgot-password/reset-password are complete, generic Vendure flows and are the part most worth keeping. Everything is displayed as priceWithTax while labelled "excl. VAT", Price defaults to EUR, delivery step hardcodes USD, country default is 'US', and no EUR conversion exists (currency switching relies on Vendure channel multi-currency which NAVIL does not configure). The home page, product tabs, product-visual classification, VIN checker, compatibility wizard, supported-vehicles brand grid, content/globeguard.ts and large parts of messages/*.json encode invented business facts (a "GlobeGuard Camper" tier, Elite B2B SLA/API, fake testimonials, generic e-commerce FAQ, brand-only compatibility with "no model or year required"). Code quality is decent (typed, consistent, Suspense/skeletons, noindex on private pages) but there are zero tests, the caching helpers do not actually cache, the /api/revalidate tag scheme matches no query, error handling is throw/console.error/alert(), the logout action does not send the auth token, verify-content.tsx calls a server action during render, several components are dead (AuthProvider, HeroSection, NavbarCollections, CurrencyPickerWrapper, SearchInput, FeaturedProducts are never mounted), and de.json contains 10 mojibake lines plus ae/oe/ue transliterations. Against the NAVIL backend the client is path- and token-compatible (shop-api, bearer+cookie) but needs schema regeneration, custom-field-aware add-to-cart (selectedBrandGroupId/selectedYear/selectedBrandGroupIds, addItemsToOrder), NET price fields, CHF default with a display-only EUR strategy, de as default locale, an auth gate before checkout, collection slugs from the NAVIL seeder, and matching email-link routes (/password-reset, /verify-email-address-change).

result.summary: The NEW backend is an almost unmodified `@vendure/create` 3.7.0 scaffold (package.json:20-33, README.md:1-3, AGENTS.md:1-3) with exactly one custom plugin, `globeguard-data`, one hand-written migration, one legacy raw-pg import script, and stock English email templates still containing the scaffold placeholders `[company header]` / `[footer text]`. The plugin implements a brand-first "compatibility wizard" model: four entities (VehicleBrand, VehicleGroup, CompatibilityRule, ImportRun), three Shop-API queries (compatibilityOptions, compatibilityRecommendation, productCompatibility) and a 946-line importer that writes directly into Vendure's tables with raw SQL from a `../data-import/dry-run.json` that does not exist on disk (only the source .xlsx/.pdf files exist; the referenced Python pipeline `globeguard_data_pipeline.py` is absent). The recommendation engine hard-codes a SKU plan (GG-BASIC-CAR, GG-PRO-DEVICE, GG-PRO-CARS, SGW-STELLANTIS-YEAR, REMOTE-DIAG-YEAR, ...) and explicitly rejects model/year logic ("Products are recommended from imported brand compatibility, not model or year locking", globeguard-data.service.ts:393), whereas NAVIL's authoritative model is per-brand-group SKUs with basicFromYear/proFromYear/SGW fromYear windows (frontend src/data/brand-compatibility.json; backend src/plugins/catalog/custom-fields.ts) and completely different SKU names (GG-ELITE-CARS-MX, GG-PRO-EXT-CAR, GG-SGW-LIC-VAG, GG-SGW-CABLE-IVE). The importer also forces the default channel to English + EUR (globeguard-import.service.ts:87,216-217,229), contradicting GlobeGuard's German/CHF setup. Configuration is wrong for the business too: `defaultLanguageCode: LanguageCode.en` (vendure-config.ts:48), a fake auto-settling "manual payment" handler (vendure-config.ts:24-45), `EmailPlugin devMode: true` (vendure-config.ts:130), and no Bexio/blog/FAQ/store-locator/CUPS/shipping plugins at all. Hygiene issues: `.env` is committed in git (git ls-files; commits ba63ab1, cfb60ad, 5bdcff6, bca1efc, 6b6c76a, 703b564) with a non-placeholder COOKIE_SECRET and DB_PASSWORD (values not reported) and scaffold-default superadmin credentials; a 1.5 MB `vendure.sqlite` is committed; `.gitignore` was added after the fact and never un-tracked these files; AGENTS.md:18 says "Do not commit .env values" — violated. The GitHub Actions deploy workflow (pm2 over SSH, default user `register`, port 222, APP_DIR apps/globeguard-backend) is byte-identical to NAVIL's `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` (same author, copied 2026-07-08), but NAVIL's actual documented Hetzner deploy is the konsoleH socket-activated supervisor `deploy/app.js` with user `drivkf` (PROJECT-CONTEXT.md:206-208); the workflow's target host is a repo secret and cannot be confirmed from disk. Net verdict: nothing in this repo should be copied verbatim into the merged backend; a handful of concepts (ImportRun audit entity, guarded `--reset`, importKey idempotency, Bexio customer custom-field names) are worth noting as ideas only.

Migrations policy (question 5): NAVIL runs synchronize:true with migrations:[] (NAVIL vendure-config.ts:120-121; HANDOFF.md:200,275; CLAUDE.md:38) and documents a synchronize race when server+worker boot together on an empty DB (PROJECT-CONTEXT.md:238). Recommended policy for the merged repo: (1) keep synchronize:true during the merge/dev phase; (2) immediately before the first production deploy (or before the beta DB holds orders/customers you cannot lose) generate ONE baseline migration with `npx vendure migrate`, commit it under src/migrations/, set synchronize:false, use `migrations: [path.join(__dirname, './migrations/*.+(js|ts)')]` and `runMigrations(config).then(() => bootstrap(config))` in index.ts (the pattern NEW uses at vendure-config.ts:76-77 and index.ts:4-5); (3) never hand-write migrations like NEW's 1783200000000 file — always generate from entities; (4) gate via an env flag (e.g. DB_SYNCHRONIZE) only for local dev, defaulting to false. result.summary: The NAVIL backend has no node_modules directory, so nothing about the Mollie plugin could be verified from installed source; package.json pins @vendure/core ^3.5.5 and lists neither @vendure/payments-plugin nor @mollie/api-client (globeguard-backend/package.json:39-61). The npm registry confirms @vendure/payments-plugin@3.5.5 exists (also 3.5.6 = latest, 3.5.7 = patch-3x) with dependency currency.js 2.0.4 and optional peer @mollie/api-client 4.x; the newer standalone @vendure-community/mollie-plugin (1.0.1) requires @vendure/core ^3.6.0-0 and therefore cannot be used with 3.5.5, even though the current docs.vendure.io page now documents that community package. Payment today: PaymentPlugin (registered at src/vendure-config.ts:210) upserts three payment methods on every boot — 'invoice' (gated to company customers), plus 'sumup' and 'paypal' which are placeholders wired to the same offline invoice handler (src/plugins/payments/payment.plugin.ts:28-56). The KustomPlugin (src/plugins/kustom/, 6 files, Swedish SEK/SE defaults) is complete but NOT registered anywhere in vendure-config.ts and is imported by no other file; the only config residue is the KUSTOM_FRONTEND_BASE_URL env alias at src/vendure-config.ts:52-53. The old NAVIL frontend has a split checkout: the cart page sends invoice customers to /cart/checkout/faktura (addPaymentToOrder with method 'invoice') and everyone else through a Kustom prepare/create-session/complete-payment REST flow (src/api/graphql/shop-checkout.ts:460-701, src/pages/cart/index.tsx:308-336), with /cart/checkout/[token] as the order-success page. The NEW frontend already has the right shape for Mollie: server-side eligiblePaymentMethods in checkout/page.tsx, a radio payment-step, a placeOrder server action that transitions to ArrangingPayment, calls addPaymentToOrder and redirects to /order-confirmation/[code] (checkout/actions.ts:104-145), and a server-rendered confirmation page reading orderByCode — but it hardcodes dummy 'standard-payment' metadata, has no external-redirect path, no pending/failed payment state on the confirmation page, and no Mollie GraphQL documents in its gql.tada client. Mollie via Vendure charges in order.currencyCode; the backend has no explicit currency configuration in vendure-config.ts, and the NEW frontend passes a currencyCode query param to the Shop API from getActiveCurrencyCode(), which conflicts with the owner's rule that EUR is display-only. Invoice/Rechnung should be kept as a second native method for company customers, but its eligibility depends on Swedish customer-group names ('Företag'/'Privat') in src/plugins/shared/customer-classification.ts:3-4.

integration_facts.fact: Shop API mutation: createMolliePaymentIntent(input: { redirectUrl?, paymentMethodCode?, molliePaymentMethodCode? (e.g. 'ideal' — skips Mollie's method selection screen), locale? (e.g. 'nl_NL'; browser language if omitted), immediateCapture? (default true), orderId? (only for ArrangingAdditionalPayment) }) returns MolliePaymentIntent { url } | MolliePaymentIntentError { errorCode message }. The storefront must redirect the shopper to `url`.
integration_facts.source: WebFetch docs.vendure.io Mollie page, Storefront Usage code block

integration_facts.fact: Shop API query: molliePaymentMethods(input: { paymentMethodCode }) { id code description minimumAmount { value currency } maximumAmount { value currency } image { size1x size2x svg } } — lists the methods enabled in the Mollie dashboard, filtered by amount/currency.

Settlement: the plugin uses Mollie's Order API (not Payments API). immediateCapture true (default) → order goes to PaymentSettled when the webhook reports paid; immediateCapture false → PaymentAuthorized after hosted checkout and manual capture (settle) later, within Mollie's 28-day authorization window. Pay-later methods (Klarna) are captured immediately unless immediateCapture:false; use false when fulfilment takes >24 h.
integration_facts.source: WebFetch docs.vendure.io Mollie page, Pay Later Methods section

integration_facts.fact: Webhook timing: Mollie gives no delivery-time guarantee; the storefront should wait for the webhook and only use `syncMolliePaymentStatus(orderCode: "…") { id state }` as a fallback after ~10 s. ArrangingAdditionalPayment: if items were added/modified after checkout, call createMolliePaymentIntent again with orderId.
integration_facts.source: WebFetch docs.vendure.io Mollie page, Force Payment Status Update / ArrangingAdditionalPayment sections

integration_facts.fact: Public reachability: the webhook is an inbound POST from Mollie to vendureHost, so the backend must be reachable from the internet over https. For local dev the docs (per prior knowledge of the page) recommend an ngrok/localtunnel URL as vendureHost; this sentence was not returned by the WebFetch extraction, so treat as unverified wording, but the technical requirement follows from the webhook mechanism.

integration_facts.fact: Order preconditions: createMolliePaymentIntent operates on the active order and (per prior knowledge of the plugin source) transitions it to ArrangingPayment itself if needed, which requires a customer, shipping address, shipping method and lines; failures come back as MolliePaymentIntentError (ORDER_PAYMENT_STATE_ERROR / INELIGIBLE_PAYMENT_METHOD_ERROR). Vendure's generic checkout flow: eligiblePaymentMethods → transitionOrderToState(ArrangingPayment) → addPaymentToOrder; order becomes PaymentAuthorized or PaymentSettled depending on the handler result.

business_rules.rule: Accounts are mandatory at checkout; unauthenticated shoppers are sent to login with a redirect back before any payment step.
Payment on invoice (Rechnung) is available only to approved company/business customers; all other customers must pay online.
Invoice payments are only Authorized at checkout and require manual settlement by staff.
Prices are NET CHF; VAT is added by delivery address (CH 8.1%, EU deliveries German VAT pending tax-zone work); EUR is a display-only conversion at CHF × 1.1 — orders are CHF.
A shipping method must be selected before the order can move to ArrangingPayment (arrangingPaymentRequiresShipping).
Payment-method presentation order in the storefront: online rail first, invoice second.
Cart lines carry GlobeGuard configuration (selectedBrandGroupId, selectedYear, selectedBrandGroupIds) as order-line customFields; any checkout rebuild must preserve them through to the placed order.
Payment-plan of record: Kustom, SumUp and PayPal placeholders are superseded by Mollie (owner instruction); docs still describe the older plan.

doc_vs_code_discrepancies: HANDOFF.md:184 says the payment plan is 'Kustom → SumUp + PayPal (with possible future Mollie)' and PROJECT-CONTEXT.md:274-275 says Kustom is the primary rail with Mollie as fallback; the owner's merge intent makes Mollie primary and drops Kustom — both docs need rewriting.

NEW frontend messages/de.json uses German-German orthography ('Straße', 'schließen') while GlobeGuard's own copy in NAVIL uses Swiss 'ss' ('Schliessen', 'abschliessen') — CLAUDE.md branding rules imply Swiss German.
