risks: Version mismatch: installing the newest Mollie package by name (@vendure-community/mollie-plugin) fails peer resolution on core 3.5.5; the correct package is @vendure/payments-plugin@3.5.5 (+ @mollie/api-client ^4). Conversely, upgrading core to 3.6/3.7 later means migrating to the community package.

Nothing Mollie-specific could be verified from installed code (no node_modules). Handler code, arg names, option names and the webhook path stated here come from prior knowledge of the plugin source and must be re-checked after `npm install` before writing the admin/bootstrap code.

Webhook reachability: Mollie must POST to the public backend. On the Hetzner setup (deploy/app.js proxy :8090 → frontend :8080 / backend :3010) the /payments/mollie/* path must be routed to the backend; locally an ngrok/localtunnel URL has to be used as vendureHost or payments will never settle (orders stay in ArrangingPayment).

Order placement happens asynchronously via webhook: the NEW confirmation page currently assumes success and never invalidates the cart tags on that route; without polling + syncMolliePaymentStatus fallback the shopper may see a 'confirmed' page for an unpaid order or a stale cart.

Currency: NEW frontend forwards a currencyCode parameter (checkout/page.tsx:30-43, api.ts:71-73). If EUR is ever enabled on the channel, Mollie will charge EUR at Vendure's stored EUR price (not CHF×1.1 display conversion). CHF-only channel + display-only conversion must be enforced deliberately.

Placeholder methods 'sumup'/'paypal' use the always-eligible checker with the offline invoice handler; if they remain in the DB they let any customer 'complete' an order without paying. Removing the definitions from code does not delete existing rows.

Invoice eligibility is keyed to Swedish group names ('Företag'); after rebranding groups to German the checker must be updated in lock-step or Rechnung silently disappears (or, worse, becomes available to everyone if a wrong checker is chosen).

Abandoned Mollie payments leave the order in ArrangingPayment; Vendure forbids line modifications in that state. The NAVIL cart contains an explicit reset to AddingItems (shop-checkout.ts:717-743) that the NEW cart/checkout lacks — customers returning from Mollie and editing the cart will hit OrderModificationError unless ported.

gql.tada in the NEW frontend types documents against src/graphql-env.d.ts; adding createMolliePaymentIntent/molliePaymentMethods without regenerating the schema from a backend that has MolliePlugin installed will fail typecheck/build.

Two-step capture (immediateCapture:false → PaymentAuthorized) interacts with Bexio invoice sync and with licence/serial fulfilment; leaving the default (immediate capture) is simpler but pay-later methods (Klarna) then capture before shipment, which Mollie/Klarna rules discourage for >24 h fulfilment.

Session continuity across the external redirect relies on the vendure-auth-token cookie set without explicit attributes (auth.ts:7); if the cookie is later hardened to SameSite=Strict the return from mollie.com would lose the session and orderByCode may 404 for the shopper.

Is public/hero-banner-bg.png (identical file in both frontends, used on the deployed beta) an approved GlobeGuard asset or an AI render to be replaced? Same question for the 76 third-party brand logos (NAVIL) vs the 30 SVGs (NEW).

Which SSH host/user do the GitHub secrets behind the identical deploy.yml in CarloUser/globeguard-backend and Bilregistret/* point to? Should that workflow be deleted from the merged repos, and which hosting path survives (Hetzner konsoleH app.js, Docker full-stack, or pm2)?

Confirm the V110 prices where HANDOFF disagrees with the data: BASIC MOTO 583 (doc 680), WoMo 848 per chassis brand x 11 SKUs (doc 880 single SKU), PRO Erweiterung MOTO 254 (doc 280); and confirm the storefront should derive all 'ab CHF' teasers from the catalogue instead of literals.

Keep 'Rechnung' (invoice, Authorized + manual settlement) for approved company customers next to Mollie? If yes: German names for the two customer groups replacing 'Privat'/'Företag', who assigns customers to them, and should UID/VAT (currently non-public custom fields) be captured at registration/checkout so Bexio and the classification agree on what a company is?
May the existing 'sumup' and 'paypal' payment-method rows be deleted/disabled in the beta database (they authorize orders without collecting money)?
Order number format to replace 'SE' + 5 digits (visible to customers and stored in Bexio api_reference)?

URL scheme for the merged frontend: German at the root with /en/ prefix (as NAVIL/old site) or /de/ + /en/ prefixes (NEW default)? Product URLs /product/<slug> (NEW) or /products/<slug> (NAVIL)? Any German slugs now (redirects are permanent)?

Email footer claims: approve or remove '100% Kompatibel', '14 Tage Rückgaberecht', 'Schneller Versand'; and supply supportPhone (NEW says +41 78 303 30 11, NAVIL has a placeholder), companyAddress, business hours (08:00-17:00 vs 09:00-17:00) and the shipping/returns/contact/blog URLs the templates link to.

Bexio: still LOCAL-only? If so we will gate the plugin behind an env flag so production has no Bexio tables/routes; if it goes live, should order sync be automatic and include shipping/discount lines and the selected brand group/year?
CUPS label printing: keep in the merged backend (gated on CUPS_SERVER_URL, without the auto-installer), or drop until fulfilment actually prints labels (no code prints today)?
Confirm car-lookup (Swedish plate lookup) is dropped entirely, and that wishlist, track-order, garage and reviews are Drivknuten-only (the draft plan drops them).

Should SGW/Truma/Erweiterung add-on quantities scale with the device quantity (2 WoMo devices -> 2 Truma cables) or stay at 1 as implemented? Should ELITE pages get a licence quantity selector like BASIC/PRO?

Mollie: does GlobeGuard GmbH have a Mollie account and test key; which methods (TWINT, cards, PostFinance, PayPal, Apple Pay, Klarna) at launch; immediate capture or authorize-then-capture; single 'Online bezahlen' choice or per-method tiles; public backend hostname for the webhook (beta and prod)?

Dashboard fork strategy: keep the 12 MB vendored @vendure/dashboard 3.5.5 + alias overlays (with the overlay repairs above) or slim to extensions plus the two intentional overrides? This also decides whether Vendure can move off 3.5.5 later.
Dark mode and typography for the merged look: keep NEW's light/dark switcher and Inter, or Roboto/light-only as on the old site?
Who supplies the German (Swiss 'ss' orthography) legal texts, the ~400 German dashboard translations, and real product photography to replace NEW's AI renders?
Store locator: are the locations partner workshops/dealers, and is the NEW /partners page to be fed from the store-locator plugin (the hardcoded NEW list disagrees with its own inventory note)?

brand-compatibility.json: OK to strip the 4 Excel legend rows in the build script, give INEOS a real basicFromYear (~2022), and resolve Lamborghini (VAG licence listed in extras.json but no SGW rule in the JSON)?
Should the NEW frontend's supply-chain .npmrc (ignore-scripts=true, min-release-age=7) be adopted anywhere in the workspace, given it breaks Vendure/sharp postinstalls?
top_risks: Channel currency is never configured in code; a fresh database seeds every price in Vendure's default (USD) and the NEW frontend would display '$' while Mollie would charge in order.currencyCode — step 3 as drafted would not catch it because nobody checks the channel.
Placeholder 'sumup'/'paypal' methods (always eligible, offline invoice handler) are re-enabled on every boot; if any survive into the merged DB a customer can complete an order without paying.

Shipping is taxed at 25% (Swedish VAT residue, shipping.plugin.ts:25) and the NAVIL cart back-computes VAT from a NET subtotal — both produce wrong money figures and are treated as follow-ups or 'keep' in the draft plan.

Dashboard route overlays query fields absent from the NAVIL schema (virtual*, virtualProductCount, fitment, invoiceEmail/paymentTermsDays); orders, collections, product and customer admin pages are likely broken today and the plan keeps the dashboard package unchanged.
The draft plan's '/api path' instruction is wrong (code uses /shop-api); following the stale PROJECT-CONTEXT would break the client and the compose healthcheck.

Mollie is asynchronous (webhook to a public vendureHost) while the NEW checkout/confirmation is synchronous, non-idempotent and shows success unconditionally; without pending/failed handling, cart reset and a reachable webhook, orders will sit in ArrangingPayment and customers will see false confirmations.

German-primary and account-mandatory rules are contradicted by the NEW base (defaultLocale 'en', guest contact step, prefixed URLs, email deep links to non-existent routes) — silent regressions in SEO, verification and password-reset flows if step 2 does not address them.

B2B gating depends on customer groups named 'Privat'/'Företag' that nothing seeds and that the Bexio plugin ignores; invoice and business shipping silently disappear (or diverge from Bexio's company inference) after the rename.

Three incompatible deploy stories (konsoleH app.js, Docker §14 with a wrong healthcheck path, third-party pm2 workflow targeting an unknown host with git reset --hard) — copying the workflow could auto-deploy the merged code to a server the owner does not control.

Email transport 'none' without SendGrid plus Vendure's default requireVerification means registration, verification and password reset dead-end in every environment lacking the key; the plan's E2E cannot run locally without a dev mailbox.

NEW gql.tada schema and queries were generated from Vendure 3.7.0 without any custom fields; against 3.5.5 + CatalogPlugin + Mollie everything must be regenerated and every catalog/cart query extended — the 'keep NEW templates' step is larger than the plan implies, and search-driven listings need facets or tierKey queries because NAVIL seeds no facets.
/health is permanently 503 because CupsPlugin registers a health indicator unconditionally; any container/LB healthcheck on /health will flap or kill the service.

Two copies of brand-compatibility.json (backend data/, frontend src/data/) with 4 junk legend rows and no sync mechanism; the merged workspace needs one generated source or the picker and seeder will drift.

Docs (HANDOFF/PROJECT-CONTEXT/CLAUDE) contain at least 14 false statements (API path, Kustom, shipping, payments, prices, WoMo model, email transport, languages, plugin inventory, ports); 'merge into updated docs' without the correction list will re-introduce fixed bugs.

Fabricated content in the NEW base (tier feature ladders, 'GlobeGuard Camper', Renault SGW, testimonials, 'SGW Bypass Payload [INJECTED]' terminal, fake downloads/status) is spread across page.tsx, footer.tsx, home-interactive-sections.tsx, content/globeguard.ts and messages/*.json — a partial port leaks false claims that conflict with the owner's marketing guardrails.
